name: Entroly Context Engine
description: Context Assurance and context engineering for every OpenClaw model route, using your own provider authentication, with protected blocks and recovery delegation.

pythonCommand.title: Python Command
pythonCommand.description: Python executable where the entroly package is installed.

preserveLastN.title: Recent Messages Preserved
preserveLastN.description: Number of recent messages kept byte-for-byte unchanged.

timeoutMs.title: Bridge Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for one Entroly context assembly request.

fallbackTokenBudget.title: Fallback Prompt Token Budget
fallbackTokenBudget.description: Operator-approved budget used when OpenClaw cannot provide one. It takes precedence over automatic registry discovery.

autoDiscoverContextBudget.title: Auto-discover Context Budget
autoDiscoverContextBudget.description: When OpenClaw omits a budget, resolve a conservative input ceiling from verified, user-supplied, or explicitly discovered model metadata. No remote discovery is enabled automatically.

receiptDir.title: Receipt Directory
receiptDir.description: Optional local directory for Entroly OpenClaw receipts.

receiptMaxFiles.title: Receipt File Limit
receiptMaxFiles.description: Fail safely instead of writing when this append-only receipt count is reached.

receiptMaxBytes.title: Receipt Byte Limit
receiptMaxBytes.description: Fail safely instead of allowing the receipt directory to exceed this byte quota.

writeReceipts.title: Write Local Receipts
writeReceipts.description: Record context hashes, estimated savings, warnings, and decision metadata locally.

distill.title: Distill Older Assistant Messages
distill.description: Remove filler from compressible older assistant responses before budget compression.

evidencePinning.title: Query-Aware Evidence Pinning
evidencePinning.description: Keep older messages that match the current request verbatim when they fit the bounded evidence reserve.

proofGuidedRecovery.title: Proof-Guided Recovery
proofGuidedRecovery.description: Opt in to local output verification and at most the configured number of OpenClaw revision passes using exact recovered evidence. Requires hooks.allowConversationAccess=true because it inspects model input and output.

proofGuidedMaxRounds.title: Maximum Proof Rounds
proofGuidedMaxRounds.description: Hard cap on model attempts, including the first response. Additional paid calls occur only when Proof-Guided Recovery is explicitly enabled.

proofGuidedRecoveryTokens.title: Recovery Token Budget
proofGuidedRecoveryTokens.description: Maximum estimated exact-evidence tokens recovered for one revision decision.

proofGuidedMaxMessages.title: Recovery Message Limit
proofGuidedMaxMessages.description: Maximum exact omitted messages appended to one revision instruction.

communicationAssurance.title: Communication Assurance
communicationAssurance.description: Opt in to local observation of channel message_received/message_sent events for durable communication state. WhatsApp separately requires channels.whatsapp.pluginHooks.messageReceived=true.

communicationStorePath.title: Communication Store Path
communicationStorePath.description: Optional absolute path for the private local communication SQLite store. By default Entroly uses the operating-system user state directory, never the workspace.

communicationRetentionDays.title: Communication Evidence Retention
communicationRetentionDays.description: Days to retain raw local communication evidence. Set 0 to disable automatic pruning.

communicationMemoryPath.title: Communication Memory Path
communicationMemoryPath.description: Optional absolute path for Entroly MemoryOS communication taste state. Defaults to the operating-system user state directory.

communicationPolicyMode.title: Communication Delegation Mode
communicationPolicyMode.description: Controls action assurance. Only bounded mode can return ALLOW for explicitly delegated low-risk categories/actions; other modes require approval for external communication.

communicationAutoActions.title: Delegated Communication Actions
communicationAutoActions.description: Low-risk action types Entroly may authorize only when communicationPolicyMode is bounded and the message category is also explicitly delegated.

communicationAutoCategories.title: Delegated Routine Categories
communicationAutoCategories.description: High-precision routine categories eligible for bounded delegation. Mixed-intent, risky, actionable, or unknown messages remain approval-only.

communicationExecution.title: Enable Bounded Communication Execution
communicationExecution.description: Expose Entroly's optional current-conversation text execution tool. Off by default; requires an ALLOW decision, atomic dispatch claim, owner authority, and OpenClaw host-bound delivery.

communicationSecretaryTools.title: Communication Secretary Tools
communicationSecretaryTools.description: Expose owner-bound optional Entroly tools for communication briefs, action assurance, and taste recall. The tools remain optional and must be allowed by OpenClaw tool policy.

communicationGlobalAccess.title: Cross-Conversation Secretary Access
communicationGlobalAccess.description: Allow the trusted owner secretary tools to review or preflight across stored conversations. Disabled by default even when communication observation is enabled.

communicationTasteLearning.title: Learn Communication Taste
communicationTasteLearning.description: Allow owner-triggered inference of low-risk style preferences from observed outbound history. Learned taste is evidence-backed and never grants send authority.
